text_block_list.text:
Голд Шипп is cool as a cucumber right
before the
Kikuka Sho, the longest of
the Classic races.
Maybe a little too
cool.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
As she leisurely sips tea and munches on
crackers,
I can't help but be concerned
about how she'll do
in the race proper.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
